linkedin:
> Use Vercel for short, stateless endpoints, especially alongside a Next.js frontend, where per-request scaling is an advantage.

Use a persistent server like Kloudbean when your API needs to run long, hold state or connections between requests, process durable background jobs, serve WebSockets, or handle high traffic on a predictable bill. The dividing line is whether your endpoints are request-shaped or process-shaped.
